guard: Private index chooses one immutable host manager binding and never revives a deleted environment admission
why: The scoped private-index writer runs against a real JWT broker. An injected native tombstone interleaving tests the race after a genuinely absent read. This is internal index, reservation and bounded bootstrap signing composition, not guest admission or hosted execution.

mutations.name: index coordinates lose their immutable account context
mutations.expectRed: private index selects one manager instance lifecycle and operation
mutations.cell: private index selects one manager instance lifecycle and operation

mutations.name: index admits stores without per-subject immutability
mutations.expectRed: native index store missing discard_new_per_subject refuses at admission
mutations.cell: native index store missing discard_new_per_subject refuses at admission

mutations.name: index admits stores without message deletion protection
mutations.expectRed: native index store missing deny_delete refuses at admission
mutations.cell: native index store missing deny_delete refuses at admission

mutations.name: index admits stores without purge protection
mutations.expectRed: native index store missing deny_purge refuses at admission
mutations.cell: native index store missing deny_purge refuses at admission

mutations.name: index admits private metadata republishing
mutations.expectRed: native index store republishing private coordinates refuses at admission
mutations.cell: native index store republishing private coordinates refuses at admission

mutations.name: index accepts plausible binding bytes on a deletion marker
mutations.find: if (entry.operation !== "PUT") throw new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", "environment admission index deletion is corruption");
mutations.expectRed: a deletion marker with plausible row bytes cannot become a binding
mutations.cell: a deletion marker with plausible row bytes cannot become a binding

mutations.name: index accepts a changed source on replay
mutations.find:
if (contractDigest(existing.row.source) !== contractDigest(source))
          throw new EpEnvelopeError("conflict", "environment already has another immutable manager admission binding");
mutations.expectRed: changed provider cannot rebind an environment
mutations.cell: changed provider cannot rebind an environment

mutations.name: index reuses the creator lifecycle for its manager
mutations.find: instanceId: mintLifecycleUid(), lifecycleUid: mintLifecycleUid(), operationId: mintLifecycleUid()
mutations.replace: instanceId: mintLifecycleUid(), lifecycleUid: source.caller.uid, operationId: mintLifecycleUid()
mutations.expectRed: private index selects one manager instance lifecycle and operation
mutations.cell: private index selects one manager instance lifecycle and operation

mutations.name: index resurrects a tombstone that races its first read
mutations.expectRed: a tombstone racing the initial read cannot resurrect an admission binding
mutations.cell: a tombstone racing the initial read cannot resurrect an admission binding

mutations.name: index ignores caller-selected manager fields
mutations.expectRed: caller-selected manager coordinates are not admitted as source fields
mutations.cell: caller-selected manager coordinates are not admitted as source fields
